name: High-Performance Ceramic Brake Pads (Front Set)
description: Performance ceramic pads for stronger bite and better fade resistance in daily + highway use.
technicalDescription: Ceramic compound designed for stable braking temps with reduced dust and noise. OEM-caliper compatible. Requires proper pad bedding.

name: Street Coilover Kit (Height Adjustable)
description: Height-adjustable coilovers for improved handling and reduced body roll with a clean stance.
technicalDescription: Threaded height adjustment with matched dampers and springs (street spec). Alignment required after install; ride height changes camber/toe.

name: High-Flow Drop-in Air Filter (Panel Type)
description: Reusable high-flow filter inside OEM airbox for better breathing and throttle response.
technicalDescription: Oiled cotton-gauze media with OEM-style sealing. Washable and reusable. Gains depend on intake condition and maintenance.

name: Stainless Catback Exhaust (Street Tone)
description: Catback exhaust for improved flow and a sporty note while staying daily-drivable.
technicalDescription: Stainless piping with performance muffler design. Bolts to stock flange points (fitment dependent). Sound varies by resonator spec.

name: Front Mount Intercooler Upgrade Kit
description: Upgraded intercooler to reduce intake temperatures and maintain consistent turbo power.
technicalDescription: Larger bar-and-plate core vs OEM for improved charge-air cooling efficiency. Leak-check required after install; clamp quality matters.

name: OBD Performance Tuner (Plug-and-Play Module)
description: Quick improvement in throttle response and torque feel without permanent ECU flashing.
technicalDescription: Sensor-intercept tuning module with selectable maps (device dependent). Gains vary with fuel quality and vehicle condition.

name: High-Flow In-Tank Fuel Pump (Drop-in)
description: Fuel pump upgrade to support tuned setups and higher fuel demand under load.
technicalDescription: Higher flow-rate in-tank pump vs OEM to maintain stable fuel delivery. Tuning may be required depending on targets and injectors.
variant: Civic X (10th Gen) - Turbo 1.5 VTEC CVT

name: OEM-Grade Radiator Assembly
description: Direct replacement radiator for stable temperatures in traffic and long drives with AC load.
technicalDescription: OE-style aluminum core with plastic end tanks. Matches OEM mounting points. Use correct coolant type and proper bleeding.

name: Forged Piston Set (Performance Build)
description: Forged pistons for better reliability under higher cylinder pressure in performance builds.
technicalDescription: Forged aluminum pistons (kit dependent). Requires machining, correct ring gaps, and professional assembly for long-term reliability.

name: Stage 1 Clutch Kit (Organic Disc)
description: Stronger clutch feel and improved holding power for daily use and mild upgrades.
technicalDescription: Organic friction disc + pressure plate with OEM-style engagement. Recommended: resurface flywheel and replace release bearing.

name: Helical Limited Slip Differential (LSD)
description: Improves traction and reduces inside-wheel spin for better acceleration out of corners.
technicalDescription: Torque-biasing helical LSD. No clutch packs. Requires professional gearbox/diff setup and correct oil selection.

name: Lightweight Alloy Wheel Set (17-inch, Set of 4)
description: Lightweight wheels to improve steering response and overall handling feel.
technicalDescription: Alloy wheel construction (model dependent). Fitment must match PCD/offset/hub bore. Recommended: alignment after install.

name: Aero Body Kit (Front Lip + Side Skirts + Rear Diffuser)
description: Adds a lower sporty look and improved styling for a cleaner profile.
technicalDescription: ABS/PU components (kit dependent). Requires precise mounting and surface prep. Professional installation recommended for best fit.

name: LED Headlight Bulb Upgrade Kit (Pair)
description: Brighter, whiter light output for improved night visibility on daily routes.
technicalDescription: LED bulbs with integrated driver (model dependent). Correct beam pattern depends on housing type. Aim headlights after install.

name: Wideband O2 Sensor (5-Wire Replacement)
description: Replacement wideband oxygen sensor for stable AFR feedback and smooth drivability.
technicalDescription: Wideband lambda sensor used for closed-loop fuel control. Correct connector and harness routing prevents heater-circuit faults.

name: Performance Brake Rotors (Slotted Front Pair)
description: Slotted rotors for improved heat management and stronger braking consistency.
technicalDescription: Precision-machined slotted surface to reduce pad glazing and improve bite. Best results with proper bedding and compatible pads.

name: Sport Lowering Springs (Progressive Rate)
description: Improves stance and reduces body roll with a comfortable daily ride feel.
technicalDescription: Progressive-rate springs to improve handling while maintaining usable ride comfort. Alignment required after installation.

name: Cold Air Intake Kit (High Flow + Heat Shield)
description: Improves airflow and throttle response with a sporty induction sound.
technicalDescription: Mandrel-bent intake tubing with high-flow filter and heat shielding (kit dependent). MAF stability depends on correct sensor seating.

name: Catback Exhaust System (Deep Tone)
description: Improved exhaust flow with a clean sporty sound while staying usable for daily driving.
technicalDescription: Stainless catback with performance muffler. Fitment depends on hanger positions and bumper clearance. Use new gaskets.

name: Front Mount Intercooler Core Upgrade
description: Reduces intake temps to help turbo power stay consistent in hot weather.
technicalDescription: Upgraded intercooler core with improved heat exchange and reduced pressure drop (kit dependent). Perform boost leak test after install.

name: ECU Scan + Live Data Monitor (Advanced OBD Tool)
description: Advanced diagnostics and live monitoring for engine parameters and fault tracing.
technicalDescription: OBD tool supports reading/clearing DTCs and live PID monitoring (feature availability depends on ECU protocol). Useful for troubleshooting.

name: Adjustable Fuel Pressure Regulator Kit
description: Helps stabilize and fine-tune fuel pressure for consistent fueling on modified setups.
technicalDescription: Adjustable regulator for rail pressure control (setup dependent). Requires correct fittings/lines and gauge verification during setup.

name: High-Capacity Aluminum Radiator Upgrade
description: Improves cooling headroom for city heat and long drives with AC load.
technicalDescription: All-aluminum radiator improves heat dissipation vs many OE plastic-tank designs. Proper bleeding and correct coolant mix required.

name: Performance Main & Rod Bearing Set
description: Engine bearing set for rebuilds focused on reliability and performance tolerances.
technicalDescription: Precision bearing shells designed for correct oil clearances (build dependent). Requires measurements, torque specs, and clean assembly.

name: CVT Transmission Cooler Kit (Aux Cooler)
description: Helps reduce CVT fluid temperatures for smoother operation in traffic and heat.
technicalDescription: Auxiliary cooler installed inline with transmission fluid routing. Proper hose routing and clamp torque required to avoid leaks.

name: Rear Differential Mount Bushing Kit (Poly)
description: Reduces drivetrain movement and improves stability during acceleration load.
technicalDescription: Polyurethane bushings reduce driveline slop vs soft OEM rubber. May slightly increase NVH. Correct orientation required.

name: Ultra-High Performance Tires (Set of 4)
description: Better grip and braking performance for confident handling on highway and wet roads.
technicalDescription: UHP performance compound (tire model dependent). Correct load rating and pressure required. Alignment recommended for even wear.

name: Aero Lip Kit (Front Lip + Side Skirts)
description: Adds a sporty look and cleaner side profile with durable street-friendly aero parts.
technicalDescription: ABS/PU lip components (kit dependent). Requires accurate positioning and secure mounting. Recommended: professional install.

name: Bi-LED Projector Retrofit Kit (Pair)
description: Sharper cutoff and stronger output for safer night driving with a premium look.
technicalDescription: Bi-LED projector retrofit requires headlight opening and resealing. Includes wiring harness (kit dependent). Proper aiming is mandatory.

name: Sport Seat + 4-Point Harness Bundle
description: Better seating support and safer restraint feel for spirited driving setups.
technicalDescription: Fixed-back style seat (variant dependent) with 4-point harness. Requires proper brackets and safe anchor points. Pro install recommended.

name: High-Flow Electric Fuel Pump (Inline)
description: Inline pump for improved fuel delivery stability on upgraded fuel setups.
technicalDescription: High-flow inline electric pump (spec dependent). Requires proper wiring relay, fuse, and secure mounting to avoid vibration/noise issues.

name: Upgraded Water Pump Assembly (OE Replacement+)
description: Reliable water pump replacement to keep coolant circulation stable in hot weather conditions.
technicalDescription: OE-style pump with improved bearing/seal quality (brand dependent). Replace gasket and bleed cooling system after installation.

name: OEM Wiring Harness Adapter (Discontinued Stock)
description: Hard-to-find OEM adapter harness for plug-and-play compatibility without cutting wires.
technicalDescription: Factory-spec connector adapter (discontinued line). Prevents splicing and helps retain OEM electrical integrity. Verify pins before install.

name: MAP Sensor Upgrade (Direct Fit)
description: More stable boost/pressure sensing for better ECU control on modified intake setups.
technicalDescription: Direct-fit MAP sensor (spec dependent). Helps ECU read manifold pressure accurately. Proper calibration may be needed on tuned vehicles.

name: Performance Ignition Coil Pack (Direct Replacement)
description: Improves spark stability for smoother acceleration and better response on tuned setups.
technicalDescription: Higher energy coil output (kit dependent) to support consistent combustion. Direct-fit replacement. Verify connector and coil dwell settings if tuned.

name: High-Flow Oil Filter (Performance Series)
description: Improved filtration and flow for engines under higher rpm and heat conditions.
technicalDescription: High-flow media with strong burst pressure rating. Helps maintain oil flow at higher demand. Replace at recommended intervals.

name: Performance Brake Fluid (DOT 4 Racing)
description: High boiling point brake fluid for improved pedal feel and fade resistance.
technicalDescription: DOT 4 racing spec with elevated dry/wet boiling points. Replace regularly for best results. Avoid mixing with unknown fluids.

name: High-Performance Spark Plugs (Iridium Set)
description: Iridium spark plugs for cleaner ignition and stable combustion under load.
technicalDescription: Fine-wire iridium center electrode for strong spark and longevity. Correct heat range matters for tuned engines. Gap to spec.

name: Cabin Air Filter (Activated Carbon)
description: Improves cabin air quality and reduces odors for a cleaner AC experience.
technicalDescription: Activated carbon filter media helps trap dust/pollen and reduce smells. Replace every 10k-15k km depending on usage.

name: Upgraded Oil Cooler Kit (Sandwich Plate Type)
description: Helps keep oil temps stable for hard driving and hot climate conditions.
technicalDescription: External oil cooler with sandwich plate. Requires correct thermostat spec (kit dependent) and proper hose routing to avoid leaks.

name: Electric Radiator Fan Upgrade (High CFM)
description: Improves airflow through radiator to reduce overheating in traffic and hot weather.
technicalDescription: High CFM fan with shroud (kit dependent). Ensure proper relay wiring and fuse. Confirm clearance with radiator and AC condenser.

name: High-Pressure Power Steering Pump (Replacement)
description: Restores steering assist and prevents pump noise for smoother daily driving.
technicalDescription: OE spec replacement power steering pump. Flush old fluid to avoid contamination. Confirm belt tension and avoid dry-running.

name: Upgrade Radiator Cap (High Pressure)
description: Increases cooling system pressure for improved boiling point and better heat control.
technicalDescription: High-pressure radiator cap (rating dependent). Use correct pressure spec to avoid stressing hoses. Helps reduce coolant boil-over.

name: High-Quality Brake Caliper Rebuild Kit
description: Rebuild kit to restore caliper performance and eliminate sticking or leaks.
technicalDescription: Includes seals and dust boots (kit dependent). Proper cleaning and piston inspection required. Use correct brake grease during assembly.

name: Air Intake Resonator Delete (Throttle Response Mod)
description: Reduces intake restriction and improves induction sound and throttle response.
technicalDescription: Resonator delete piece (fitment dependent). May increase intake noise. Ensure clamps are tight to prevent unmetered air.

name: Performance Panel Air Filter (Washable)
description: Reusable performance filter for improved airflow inside OEM airbox.
technicalDescription: Washable filter media with OEM-style sealing. Helps reduce restriction. Clean and re-oil (if applicable) at service intervals.

name: Upgraded Ignition Wires (Low Resistance Set)
description: Improves spark delivery stability and reduces misfire chance in older ignition setups.
technicalDescription: Low-resistance performance wire set (engine dependent). Heat-resistant insulation. Ensure correct routing to avoid arcing.

name: Engine Mount Insert Kit (Poly Upgrade)
description: Reduces engine movement for better throttle response and improved shifting feel.
technicalDescription: Poly inserts stiffen OEM mounts (fitment dependent). Can increase cabin vibration slightly. Torque fasteners to spec.
